SELECT COALESCE(c.name, '미분류') AS name, SUM(t.amount) AS value, COALESCE(c.color, '#64748b') AS color FROM transactions t LEFT JOIN categories c ON t.category_id = c.id WHERE t.status = '승인' AND t.user_id = #{userId}
AND t.transaction_date >= #{dateStart}::date
AND t.transaction_date <= #{dateEnd}::date
GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.color ORDER BY value DESC

SELECT TO_CHAR(t.transaction_date, 'YYYY-MM') AS month, SUM(t.amount) AS amount FROM transactions t WHERE t.status = '승인' AND t.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY TO_CHAR(t.transaction_date, 'YYYY-MM') ORDER BY month

SELECT TO_CHAR(transaction_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS date, SUM(SUM(amount)) OVER (ORDER BY transaction_date) AS cumulativeAmount FROM transactions WHERE status = '승인' AND user_id = 1
AND transaction_date >= #{dateStart}::date
AND transaction_date <= #{dateEnd}::date
GROUP BY transaction_date ORDER BY transaction_date
